title: On a phone the Customer card shows the same Bill To field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a phone, or a browser window 390 pixels wide.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Tap to open the work order details.
  3. Tap the Bill To field.
  4. Tap customer C in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, in the phone layout.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows "Bill To" under Authorizer, reading customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The searchable list opens without any hover.

Step 4:

  • "Bill To" reads customer C's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • Story 3, Form factor: “Form factor: Mobile-optimized: the same Customer card on phones; the field is a standard searchable select with no hover-only control.”
  • S3-R1: “The card's expanded section shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer.”
  • S3-R5: “Picking a customer saves the Bill To immediately; picking "(this customer)" makes the customer pay for itself.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "This customer" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build), "Part sale P2-256" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build), "S2-17579" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build), "Picked" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build).
